Native QA and independent binary64 ties/subnormal boundaries verify represented values;NaN payload/physical ABI and other RTL numeric APIs are not claimed. Sign/zero/nonfinite thresholds, decimal-power constants and the representable-integer exception follow sal/rtl/math.cxx and include/rtl/math.hxx; existing C numeric parser is reused unchanged. Native binary64 JavaScript arithmetic and decimal conversion replace native allocation/ABI details. Pinned SAL QA values and boundary tests provide bounded evidence; full RTL math and universal libm last-bit equivalence are not claimed. Existing scalar and float adapters share this algorithm. Host shortest binary64 text replaces Dragonbox;native ignored-trailing-zero scale is restored from binary64 fields and original checked Dragonbox integer-log constants. Actual rtl_math_doubleToUString replacement and insertion use existing SAL allocation/buffer/ref owners. Genuine full69normal+69ASanUBSan SAL/CPPU graphs verify complete captured units,terminator,capacity,relative identity and refs,with original source/config/object hashes and bounded binary64 observations. Initial actual ASan evidence identifies upstream negative-F stack-allocation overflow;conservative source-bound filtering excludes that undefined memory domain from returned-output observations without disabling sanitizers. This is not exhaustive binary64 or host-runtime/Dragonbox/ABI proof;other RTL APIs,full OUStringBuffer,font-axis output,item/pool/UI integration remain pending. Task76 native General-format dependency:ports original RTL round across all8selectors and approxValue with actual binary64 exponent/significand inspection,original decimal-literal powers,corrected approximation,signed zero,precision clamps and overflow restoration. JS lacks fenv,so HalfEven uses the original native fallback;release unknown-selector behavior remains unchanged.
